title: Social Media Dataset Survey — Pipeline
description:
Pipeline for a data-centric survey of publicly available, English, text-based social media datasets, accompanying the paper A Survey on Publicly Available Text-Based English Social Media Datasets From Online Data Sharing Repositories.

The code queries fourteen open data repositories — Kaggle, Zenodo, GitHub, Figshare, Hugging Face, Dryad, OSF, Harvard Dataverse, Science Data Bank, data.gov, the EU Open Data Portal, Mendeley Data, CESSDA and Research Data Australia — via their REST APIs or, where none exists, via OAI-PMH. It then deduplicates the results, classifies relevance with an LLM validated against human annotation, and reproduces the exploratory analysis reported in the paper.

The pipeline has four steps: one harvesting script per repository, all sharing a common output schema; a merge and deduplication step; an LLM classification and evaluation step; and an analysis step in R producing every figure in the paper.

The catalogue this code produced — 1,997 hand-annotated datasets drawn from 7,291 retrieved records — is published as a separate Zenodo record; see the related identifiers.
